mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT A.PORTFOLIO_ID id, A.PORTFOLIO_NAME text, DATE_FORMAT(A.VDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as VDATE, DATE_FORMAT(A.MDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as MDATE, A.PORTFOLIO_TYPE, A.PROFIT_TYPE FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO A inner join PA_PTL_PORTFOLIO B on A.PORTFOLIO_ID = B.PORTFOLIO_ID
(A.PROFIT_TYPE = #{PROFIT_TYPE_HBX} or (A.PROFIT_TYPE = #{PROFIT_TYPE_JZX} and B.OPEN_TYPE in (#{PTL_ISSUE_MODE_FBS}, #{PTL_ISSUE_MODE_DQKF})) ) and A.PORTFOLIO_TYPE in (#{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_CPZH}, #{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_XNZH})
and (A.PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR A.PORTFOLIO_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') )
AND A.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{initValue}
and A.PORTFOLIO_ID in (select PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY where USER_ID = #{loginUserName})
